name: sre-agent
description: Agentic SRE orchestrator: evidence-first incident investigation, ranked root-cause hypotheses, approval-gated remediation, and FinOps reports with every number proved. Distributed as a Claude Code plugin and as standard Agent Skills

plugins.name: sre-agent
plugins.description: Agentic SRE orchestrator: evidence-first incident investigation across Kubernetes, Prometheus metrics, Loki or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch logs, Tempo/Jaeger traces, service-mesh state, and recent changes; ranked root-cause hypotheses; approval-gated remediation with rollback plans; validation, optionally under k6 load; and final incident reports. Also answers cloud cost questions on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes with FinOps reports whose every number is proved against saved query results.
